title: ChFC® Designation (Chartered Financial Consultant)
body: The American College of Financial Services
source: The American College of Financial Services Curriculum Catalog
summary: The premier modular financial consulting credential with comprehensive depth in small business planning, executive compensation, estate planning, and taxation across 9 modular courses (7 Core + 2 Electives).

standard.name: Standard Modular Consulting Track
standard.blurb: Complete 9 comprehensive modular courses (7 core + 2 electives), pass all 9 two-hour proctored exams, and verify 3 years of financial advisory experience.

stages.title: Stage 1: Foundational Financial Consulting Core
stages.subtitle: HS 300, HS 311, and HS 313: Fundamentals, Business Owners, and Insurance

nodes.name: HS 300: Financial Planning: Process and Environment
nodes.description: Financial planning process, code of ethics, financial statements, time value of money, education funding, and consumer credit.

nodes.name: HS 311: Planning for Business Owners and Professionals
nodes.description: Choosing business entities, buy-sell agreements, corporate tax planning, business valuation, and executive compensation plans.

nodes.name: HS 313: Individual Life Insurance
nodes.description: Term, whole, universal, and variable life insurance policies; policy taxation, riders, surrender values, and insurance trust integration.

stages.title: Stage 2: Advanced Investment, Tax & Retirement Core
stages.subtitle: HS 321, HS 326, and HS 328: Investments, Retirement, and Taxation

nodes.name: HS 321: Investments
nodes.description: Equity and debt valuation, mutual funds, asset allocation, modern portfolio theory, performance measurement, and market efficiency.

nodes.name: HS 326: Planning for Retirement Needs
nodes.description: Qualified retirement plans (401k, defined benefit), IRAs, Social Security optimization, distribution rules, and required minimum distributions.

nodes.name: HS 328: Investments & Taxation
nodes.description: Federal income taxation of individuals, property transactions, capital gains and losses, tax-advantaged investments, and AMT.

stages.title: Stage 3: Estate Planning & Specialized Electives
stages.subtitle: HS 330, HS 347, and Elective: Estate, Contemporary Applications & Elective

nodes.name: HS 330: Fundamentals of Estate Planning
nodes.description: Wills, probate, revocable and irrevocable trusts, gift and estate taxes, generation-skipping transfer tax, and charitable giving vehicles.

nodes.name: HS 347: Contemporary Applications in Financial Planning
nodes.description: Capstone case study course integrating all areas of personal financial planning into customized client solution blueprints.

nodes.name: Modular Elective (HS 325 or HS 334)
nodes.description: Candidate selects one elective: HS 325 (Nonqualified Deferred Compensation and Executive Benefits) or HS 334 (Estate Planning Applications).

stages.title: Stage 4: Experience & Designation Award
stages.subtitle: 3 Years Qualifying Experience + American College Code of Ethics

nodes.name: 3 Years Full-Time Financial Advisory Experience
nodes.description: Demonstrate at least 3 years of full-time professional experience in financial planning, insurance, investments, banking, or accounting.

nodes.name: ChFC® Designation Conferred & Ethics Pledge
nodes.description: Award of the Chartered Financial Consultant (ChFC®) designation and commitment to The American College Code of Ethics and Professional Pledge.
